status: draft — written for the prototype, not yet reviewed by a primary music educator

questions.sound: Listen again. Which note sounded different?
questions.rest: Which beat was meant to stay quiet?
questions.timing: What did you notice about your taps and the beat?
questions.duration: Which sound needed to last longer?
questions.missing: Was there a sound you skipped?
questions.passed: What helped you play it this way?
questions.insufficient: Shall we listen once and try again?

observations.wrongNote: Note {count} was {played}. The music asked for {expected}.
observations.rest: There was a tap on beat {beat}, which is a rest.
observations.extra: There was an extra sound near beat {beat}.
observations.duration: Note {count} was let go after {held} beats. It lasts {want} beats.
observations.steady: Your taps stayed close to the beat.
observations.early: Most of your taps came a little before the beat.
observations.late: Most of your taps came a little after the beat.
observations.speedingUp: Your taps started with the beat, then got faster.
observations.slowingDown: Your taps started with the beat, then got slower.
observations.uneven: The spaces between your taps changed a lot.
observations.insufficient: There were not enough sounds to say much about the timing.
observations.passed: Every sound matched. {onTime} of {total} landed on the beat.

replies.pulse-with-mine: Hear your own taps with a steady click under them.
replies.pulse-slower: Hear your taps again, a little slower, with a steady click.
replies.target-slower: Hear the pattern slowly, then try with it.
replies.mine-with-rest: Hear your pattern with that beat left quiet.

choices.check: Try a new one on my own
